author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: An original small bivalved arthropod for an imaginative prehistoric world. Static artistic interpretation inspired by Waptia fieldensis, with separated appendages and a quietly curved ringed abdomen.
description.zh: 为奇想史前世界创作的小型双瓣甲节肢动物。以瓦普塔虾为灵感的静态艺术化演绎，附肢清晰分离，环节腹部轻轻弯曲。

sources.consulted: Description / Morphology; maximum size; institutional reconstruction image visually inspected only.

reconstruction_notes: Original modeled geometry; no reference artwork, scan, third-party model or image incorporated.
Ochre and sand colors, restrained coarse facets and gentle pose are artistic. Opaque materials do not claim fossil-known translucency.
Two stalked eyes, one pair of elongated antennules, bivalved anterior carapace, separated limbs, ringed limbless abdomen and paired caudal flaps.
Tiny setae and mouthpart details are simplified or omitted; no complete appendage-level certification or modern shrimp identity is claimed.
Body length is 80 mm from anterior head to caudal tips; antennules extend beyond this anatomical length.
Connected internal limb roots and shell hinge overlaps are intentional; no rig or animation included.
